deadline.value: Priority consideration for admission and departmental funding is January 15; the final deadline is March 1.
deadline.quote: January 15: Priority consideration for admission and to be considered for departmental funding

toefl_min.value: International applicants need TOEFL iBT 100 with a speaking score of 20.
toefl_min.quote: The TOEFL with a minimum of 100 on the IBT and a speaking score of 20

ielts_min.value: IELTS 6.5 overall with no sub-score below 6.0.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS with a minimum score of 6.5 with no individual sub-score below 6.0

funding.value: Financial assistantships with tuition and a competitive stipend are awarded on merit.
funding.quote: Awards of financial assistantships, which includes graduate tuition and a competitive stipend, are made to applicants of the PhD program on the basis of merit

entry_route.value: A baccalaureate in mechanical engineering or a closely allied field is required; master's holders are assessed on the same criteria.
entry_route.quote: A baccalaureate degree in mechanical engineering or in a closely allied field of science or mathematics

also.quote: The acceptance of applicants who have already received a Master’s degree in engineering will be based on the above minimum criteria

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The department pages do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

notes: Ocean Engineering PhD (CEOE and COE) is not saved as a record: the Civil Engineering FAQ gives a 308 combined GRE minimum for Ocean Engineering applicants, and its funding deadline is February 1 with a July 1 final date.
